name: Collision Detection & Measurement
description: Detect and measure collisions between 3D geometries using SDF-based penetration analysis. Computes penetration depth, collision region, and bounding box intersection.

theory.overview:
Collision detection between 3D objects can be performed using Signed Distance Fields (SDF). Given a static mesh $S$ and a moving mesh $M$, we sample points on $M$ and compute their signed distance to $S$:

$$d(p) = \text{SDF}_S(p), \quad p \in M$$

Points where $d(p) < 0$ lie inside the static mesh, indicating collision. The penetration depth is:

$$\delta = \max_{p \in M} |\min(d(p), 0)|$$

This approach is robust for arbitrary mesh geometries and provides continuous penetration measurements.

sdf_collision.title: SDF-Based Collision Detection
sdf_collision.content:
Samples points uniformly on the input mesh surface (seeded), places a synthetic obstacle sphere along +x so that it overlaps the surface met by a ray from the bounding-box centre by `penetration_ratio` x its radius, and computes the SDF of the input points against the obstacle (sign by a majority of `sign_rays` rays).

Penetrating points satisfy $\text{SDF}(p) < 0$. Points are coloured by signed distance normalised by the obstacle radius: penetrating points at the red end of the colormap, safe points at the blue end.

penetration_depth.title: Penetration Depth Measurement
penetration_depth.content:
Places a synthetic obstacle sphere along +x so that it overlaps the surface met by a ray from the bounding-box centre by `overlap_distance`, samples the input surface (seeded) and computes the maximum penetration depth:

$$\delta = |\min_i \text{SDF}(p_i)|$$

(sign by a majority of `sign_rays` rays). Also computes the bounding box of the collision region and outputs a combined point cloud showing the penetration zone with colour-coded depth.

parameters.name: obstacle_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the synthetic obstacle sphere.

parameters.name: penetration_ratio
parameters.description: Fraction of obstacle radius for penetration overlap.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of surface sample points for SDF evaluation.

parameters.name: obstacle_resolution
parameters.description: Sphere tessellation resolution for the synthetic obstacle mesh.

parameters.name: obstacle_viz_points
parameters.description: Points sampled on the obstacle for visualization.

parameters.name: colormap
parameters.description: Matplotlib colormap used to color points by signed distance.

parameters.name: sign_rays
parameters.description: Rays voting inside/outside per point (odd); 1 is Open3D's default and can flip a sign.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed of the surface sampling (same seed, same reported depths).
